tagline: A CV tailored to every opportunity
brief: A CV tailoring app helping job seekers shape their experience for each role. The identity should feel considered, personal and polished, with an editorial touch.
criteria: The Stitched T should work as a one-colour symbol, stay recognizable in app and browser icons, and pair with a refined Tailor wordmark.

concepts.name: Stitched T
concepts.idea: A T finished with precise stitch holes, expressing care in tailoring a CV to a role.
rationale: Simple letterform reads quickly as an app symbol
Stitches connect the Tailor name to careful, personal editing
Berry and editorial serif bring warmth to a job-search tool

recommendation: Use the horizontal lockup in the app header and the simplified T in browser tabs and app icons.
next_steps: Apply the favicon and manifest links from head-snippet.html when integrating the icon set
Check the chosen color against the app interface before wider rollout
Complete a trademark search before commercial launch
